verdict.top_defect: Stripping the assembler empties `_superseded_drafting_skills` in agent_runtime, so the manifest-derived suppressor of the monolithic drafting skill is gone and only a hardcoded skill-id string match prevents Claude from redrafting over the authoritative preseeded/reused section — and the new seam hardcodes `resolve_skill_ids`, so it cannot catch that drift.

Suppression now covers reuse mode but the compensating worst-wins roll-up guard is wired only into preseed, so a reused section with overall_status 'confirmed' over an unresolved declared claim goes green while the retained canonical_pack_deriver republishes that declaration under the current run_id

Comment claims the import guard catches a new undeclared draft-consumer, but `DRAFT_CONSUMING_COMPONENTS - set(COMPONENT_REGISTRY)` only catches the rename direction; the addition direction rests on a test detector that greps adapter source for the substrings 'section_assembler'/'assumption_applier' and asserts len()==6, so a consumer reaching section_drafts/ via any other module escapes both silently.
